note: Alberta Parks recreation area 40 km west of Sundre on the Forestry Trunk Road (Hwy 734), self-maintained by the Friends of the Eastern Slopes Association: sites in the forest between the James River and Wilson Creek, with a camp kitchen with a rock fireplace. Pack out all garbage; bring toilet paper. OHVs are permitted, on established roadways only, and OHV trails are nearby. --Claude

flags: OHV (possible drop candidate, reviewer's call): the Alberta Parks page says 'Hike, fish, or access nearby OHV trails. The use of OHVs is permitted at this campground. Please keep OHVs on established roadways within the recreation area.' FOESA repeats 'Easy access to hike, fish or utilize nearby OHV trails. The use of OHV's is permitted at this campground.' Neither page uses 'staging' or names a trail system or OHV zone; the stored note's 'OHV staging' had no source and was dropped.
